conviction_note: Mega-cap with 24 analysts and no pre-release. The one real line is the FY2026 guide: H1 sales grew +15.7% at CER against a full-year guide of 'around 10%', which leaves room for a raise, and Jefferies flagged one publicly on 7 Oct. That is mostly in the price after a +7% run from 71.01 to 75.93 over eight sessions with no news. Sanofi was also sold -9% on a beat plus a raise in July, and Merck's Enflonsia today is a small negative for Beyfortus. So p_up sits barely above 50 (53) on an abs move of 4.5 sized for a likely guidance event. That gives +0.27 scaled against a findings sum of +0.95. The gap is there because the findings are sized on their own and the sign uncertainty lives only in p_up.

already_public.what: FY2026 guidance upgraded at Q2: sales growth around 10% at CER, business EPS slightly faster; H1 sales +15.7% CER, Q2 +17.8%; 'anticipating normalisation of growth in the second half'

Q3 aide-memoire: vaccines down low- to mid-teens in Q3 on flu Q3/Q4 phasing, FX about +2% on sales and +1% on business EPS, Beyfortus facing increasing US/EU competition from a new monoclonal, divestment drag about EUR50m in Q3, inspection-related shipment delays on Nexviazyme/Myozyme already in the guide
Regeneron alliance expansion: $1.0bn upfront from Sanofi plus up to $7.0bn of milestones, and Regeneron's Dupixent information lawsuit settled
Jefferies preview: Q3 sales 1% above Visible Alpha consensus, Dupixent 4% above, FY2026 targets could be slightly raised

new_in_release.expect: FY2026 guide likely nudged up or firmed toward the top, since H1 +15.7% vs about 10% FY leaves H2 at about +5% CER. A raise is expected by at least one broker, so a reiteration would read as a disappointment. Direction up, mostly priced.
Q3 sales and business EPS modestly above consensus on US Dupixent volume/price (Jefferies), with vaccines down low-to-mid teens as guided. Small beat.
Beyfortus season under more competition (Merck Enflonsia Q3 +138%). Q4 vaccine recovery language matters. Mild negative risk.
First quarters under the new CEO's 'accelerated transformation roadmap'. Any rebasing, restructuring or 2027 commentary (Lovenox/Cheplapharm transfer from Q1 2027) is unknown in sign and is the tail.
Q2 FCF was strong (EUR2.67bn, +86.8%). The Regeneron upfront falls in Q4, not Q3. Unknown, likely neutral.

findings.finding: The FY2026 guide (sales about +10% CER) sits far below H1 growth of +15.7% CER, so an unchanged guide implies H2 of only about +5%. A raise or firming of the guide is mechanically likely on the release, and Jefferies publicly expects 'slightly raised' targets.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (2026-07-30) raised the guide and beat business EPS (2.09 vs 1.90 est.), and the stock fell 8.95% vs CAC +0.92% on IFRS profit and costs. Q3 2025 +2.52%. Q1 2026 confirmed guide, +1.21%. Raises have not reliably been bought here.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The arithmetic is public and Jefferies said it out loud on 7 Oct, and the stock has run from 71.01 (19 Oct) to 75.93 (29 Oct) without company news, which is what an expected raise looks like. What is not priced is the size of any raise and whether the new CEO uses it or holds back for a rebasing. If a raise were fully priced the stock would not have printed a 2018 low on 2 Oct.
findings.independence: Jefferies note via CercleFinance/Zonebourse (French wire): 'Jefferies estime que les objectifs 2026 pourraient être légèrement relevés' https://www.easybourse.com/sante/news/1538949/sanofi-pourrait-legerement-relever-ses-objectifs-selon-jefferies.html

findings.finding: Jefferies models Q3 sales 1% above Visible Alpha consensus and Dupixent 4% above, on US volume and a favourable price effect from better distribution-channel efficiency. That offsets the guided vaccine weakness.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Business EPS beat consensus in all four quarters in the baseline (+4.4% to +10.0%). Reactions to those beats: +2.52%, -0.59%, +1.21%, -8.95%. Beats are not reliably rewarded.
findings.original_quote: La banque d'investissement américaine table sur un chiffre d'affaires 1% au-dessus du consensus Visible Alpha. Dans le détail, les volumes de Dupixent aux Etats-Unis et l'anticipation d'un effet prix favorable lié à l'amélioration de l'efficacité des circuits de distribution conduisent les analystes à prévoir des ventes de Dupixent de 4% supérieures aux attentes. (The US investment bank expects sales 1% above the Visible Alpha consensus; US Dupixent volumes and an expected favourable price effect from more efficient distribution channels lead it to forecast Dupixent 4% above expectations.)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: it is a broker preview on the wire. It is filed because a 4% Dupixent beat on a product that is 44% of sales is about 1.8% of group sales, and the Q2 Dupixent figure carried a one-off gross-to-net benefit, so whether that is repeated is not known. Regeneron has not reported Q3 yet (latest 8-K is the 6 Oct IPR&D pre-announcement), so no counterparty has confirmed Dupixent.
findings.independence: none: no counterparty Dupixent figure for Q3 2026 exists yet (Regeneron filings list checked https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0000872589.json)

findings.finding: Merck reported Q3 2026 today: Enflonsia, the RSV infant antibody competing with Beyfortus, sold $187m (US $141m vs $78m a year ago, +138%) on 'seasonal demand and associated inventory build'. That points to share loss for Beyfortus (Q3 2025 EUR739m) in the season-stocking quarter.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Beyfortus drove the Q3 2025 vaccine beat (+19.8%), a quarter the stock rose 2.52%. No history of a Beyfortus miss.
findings.why_not_priced: Released today during the Paris session, and Sanofi still closed up (75.93, +0.6%), so it has not been marked down. Sanofi's aide-memoire already says competition is increasing, so part of it is inside what the company guided. Net of the rest of the company: Beyfortus is about 6% of quarterly sales, and the incremental Enflonsia dollars (~$60m US) are about 0.5% of Sanofi sales.
findings.independence: Sanofi aide-memoire: 'In 2026, competition is increasing in the US and EU with the entry of a new monoclonal antibody' https://www.sanofi.com/assets/dotcom/content-app/events/quaterly-results/2026/2026-q3-2026-results/20261006-Sanofi-Q3-2026-Aide-memoire.pdf

findings.finding: GSK's Q3 2026 influenza vaccines fell 17% at CER on 'US competitive pressure and delayed timing of deliveries'. Delivery timing slipped industry-wide, which corroborates Sanofi's guided Q3-to-Q4 flu phasing shift rather than a demand problem.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025: vaccines declined and the stock still rose 2.52%. The market has looked through flu phasing before.
findings.why_not_priced: Inside what Sanofi guided (low-to-mid-teens Q3 vaccine decline), so it moves the number toward 0. Filed because it is the only independent counterparty read on the Q3 flu shift. It is consistent with the guide, not a surprise.
findings.independence: Sanofi aide-memoire on the atypical strain-selection timelines https://www.sanofi.com/assets/dotcom/content-app/events/quaterly-results/2026/2026-q3-2026-results/20261006-Sanofi-Q3-2026-Aide-memoire.pdf

findings.finding: On 14 Oct the European Commission accepted Sanofi's commitments to close its antitrust probe into communications disparaging CSL Seqirus's flu vaccine, with no fine reported. A one-off legal risk is removed before the print.
findings.original_quote: L'autorité européenne de la concurrence a annoncé mercredi avoir accepté les engagements proposées par Sanofi afin de mettre fin à une enquête au sujet d'un possible comportement anticoncurrentiel concernant la promotion d'un vaccin contre la grippe pour les patients vulnérables. (The EU competition authority announced Wednesday it accepted Sanofi's commitments to end an investigation into possible anticompetitive conduct over the promotion of a flu vaccine for vulnerable patients.)
findings.why_not_priced: Already public on 14 Oct and a one-off with no path to the guide. Sized at 0. Filed because it is a sourced fact that removes a tail rather than adding news.

outside_window.finding: Regeneron alliance Sixth Amendment: $1.0bn upfront paid by Sanofi plus up to $7.0bn of milestones for four long-acting IL-13/IL-4/IL-4Ra/bispecific antibodies, with development costs shared. The cash and accounting effects land in Q4 2026 and later, and Sanofi capitalises licence payments, so there is no Q3 business EPS effect.

Cheplapharm divestment of about EUR1.2bn of 2025 sales (Lovenox about EUR0.8bn), with the commercial transfer from Q1 2027. It affects the 2027 base, and Sanofi normally guides the new year in January.
Venglustat GD3 FDA decision, target action date 2026-11-25

baseline_tension: The findings lean mildly positive, against the small negative priced lean (-0.197, the run-up term only). But the +3.9% 20-day and +7% eight-session run-up already looks like the market pricing the expected raise, so the evidence agrees with the tape more than it beats it.

The EU Commission's acceptance of Sanofi's flu-vaccine promotion commitments (14 Oct) surfaced through French Agefi-Dow Jones copy on ABC Bourse; English searches did not return it

lessons_applied: 'The move is in the guide' (guidance changes median 9.0%, guidance findings 11 of 17 on sign): the guidance finding is raised from +0.6 to +0.9 and sized on the guidance scale, still held below that scale because this name sold its last raise

'Too small about the move' (18 of 23 under, factor about 3): abs_move_pct raised from 4.0 to 4.5. It is held well below the 9% guidance-change median because this is a 24-analyst mega-cap whose own results-day moves have a median of about 1.7% with 8-9% tails
Reaction history vetoes direction, not size: the July -9% on a beat and raise keeps p_up at 53 and does not shrink abs_move_pct
Truncated zero on the short register: positioning_check states it is the 0.5% floor and not a measurement (anchor_covered false)
